name: Security Guard Operations
audience: small contract security companies and guard supervisors
topic: incident review and post-order control for guard companies

products.name: Incident Report Review
products.product: A focused security incident report review workflow workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small contract security companies and guard supervisors
products.problem: Guard reports can be submitted with missing timeline, people, location, actions, or media, while supervisors need to review and deliver client-ready records quickly.
products.valueProposition: Turns security incident report review workflow into a visible operating queue so every submitted incident report is checked for completeness, corrected with an audit trail, and delivered to authorized recipients.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets security incident report review, guard report approval, incident report quality control, and security supervisor workflow searches.

products.name: Post Order Acknowledgment
products.product: A focused security guard post order acknowledgment workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small contract security companies and guard supervisors
products.problem: Updated post orders may sit in binders, messages, or portals without proof that every assigned guard received the effective instructions before the shift.
products.valueProposition: Turns security guard post order acknowledgment into a visible operating queue so every guard assigned to a post acknowledges the effective order and required briefing before working under it.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets security post orders, guard post order acknowledgment, security site instructions, and guard training confirmation searches.
